item.name: P2-05 AxPut core HTTP and provider review
item.description: Run only against a reviewed disposable transaction/schema. Covers create values/{}, stored-state and overlay edits, header/body version matching, retained/destroyed finalization, stale and StructDef conflicts, validation, rollback, response omission, and legacy response compatibility.

exec: pm.test('Known version is numeric and retained state is reported', () => { pm.expect(body.version).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.dataObjectRetained).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Empty SubmitData still returns saved object state', () => { pm.expect(body.objectid).to.match(/^[0-7][0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{25}$/); pm.expect(body.version).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.dataObjectRetained).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 02 New object without Data is rejected

exec: pm.test('Missing Data is rejected before Save', () => pm.expect(body.message).to.include('Data must contain at least one item'));
pm.test('No objectid is generated for an invalid request', () => pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('objectid'));

request.description: Creates the shared DataObject used by the P2-02 AxPut checks. The key must identify a record in the reviewed disposable schema.

exec: pm.test('Disposable Init returns objectId and version', () => { pm.expect(body.objectId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.version).to.be.a('number'); });

item.name: 04 Existing object without Data hydrates stored state

exec: pm.test('Finalized state is retained without pending cleanup', () => { pm.expect(body.dataObjectRetained).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('dataObjectFinalizationPending'); });

item.name: 04b Existing object overlay edit uses matching header and body version

exec: pm.test('Matching If-Match and expectedVersion overlay advances once', () => { pm.expect(body.objectid).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('axPutExistingObjectId')); pm.expect(body.version).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('axPutVersion')) + 1); pm.expect(body.dataObjectRetained).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Unknown object returns supplied id and omits version', () => { pm.expect(body.objectid).to.eql('01JUNKNOWNOBJECT00000000000'); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('version'); });

pm.test('Stale version code, current version, and retained state', () => { pm.expect(body.errorcode).to.eql('AXD-CONC-001'); pm.expect(body.version).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('axPutNegativeVersion'))); pm.expect(body.dataObjectRetained).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 07 Invalid overlay is rejected before SQL

exec: pm.test('Invalid overlay code, retained version, and retained state', () => { pm.expect(body.errorcode).to.eql('AXD-REQ-001'); pm.expect(body.version).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('axPutNegativeVersion'))); pm.expect(body.dataObjectRetained).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Validation failure returns current retained state', () => { pm.expect(body.errorcode).to.eql('AXD-REQ-001'); pm.expect(body.version).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('axPutNegativeVersion'))); pm.expect(body.dataObjectRetained).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 07c StructDef mismatch after manual hash change

request.description: Run only after replacing this object's stored StructDef hash as described in README.md.

exec: pm.test('StructDef conflict returns current retained version', () => { pm.expect(body.errorcode).to.eql('AXD-CONC-003'); pm.expect(body.version).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('axPutNegativeVersion'))); pm.expect(body.dataObjectRetained).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 08 Configured child or mapping failure rolls back

request.description: Configure a disposable transaction whose child, GenMap, MdMap, or database command fails after an earlier batch. Verify database effects separately as described in README.md.

item.name: 10 Active object stale version is rejected

exec: pm.test('Stale version returns current retained version', () => { pm.expect(body.errorcode).to.eql('AXD-CONC-001'); pm.expect(body.version).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('axPutDestroyVersion'))); pm.expect(body.dataObjectRetained).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 11 Successful Save destroys DataObject after commit

exec: pm.test('Destroyed Save advances once and reports final state', () => { pm.expect(body.version).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('axPutDestroyVersion')) + 1); pm.expect(body.dataObjectRetained).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('dataObjectFinalizationPending'); });
